title: N -W F P Local Government Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1994
ACT II OF 1994
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 18th July, 1994]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/94/12018, dated
18-7-1994.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Amendment) Bill,
1994, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 28th June, 1994 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 13th July, 1994 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 22nd March, 1994.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Amendment of section 31 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979

ACT II OF 1994
ACT II OF 1994
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 18th July, 1994]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/94/12018, dated
18-7-1994.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Amendment) Bill,
1994, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 28th June, 1994 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 13th July, 1994 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 31 of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979.-- In
the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979 (N.-W.F.P.
Ordinance IV of 1979), in section 31, in clause (a) of the third proviso, for
the words "within a period not exceeding twenty eight months from the
date of dissolution of the Local Council" the words "on a date to 'be
determined by the Government" shall be substituted.
